acceptance: A source session is bound to exactly one verified grant by caller, application, exact origin, principal and runtime; absent, ambiguous, stale, revoked or inconsistent identity fails closed; scopes come from the one bound grant.

positive.fixture: a session bound to one verified grant; two origins and two people keep their own grants and scopes; concurrent sign-ins leave one live grant

negative.fixture: ten mismatching sessions, two live grants in 50 lookups, OAuth and unverified grants, principal switch cancels queued work

versions.schema: unchanged; execution.Session gains Origin and Generation (Go struct only)

security_and_source_permissions: Ambiguity fails closed and is audited; scopes are never unioned.
performance_memory_storage: Lookup is linear in the owner grants.
known_limitations: Uniqueness of live grants per source is enforced by fail-closed lookup, not by the store
